question: 10.7f 的 readout_selection_absent 能否用来支持「动作打分的参数化形状是瓶颈」这一推论
method: read-only audit of existing fixture and report; no training, no new checkpoint

fixture.split_rule: scripts/training/verify_taiji_selection_10_7f.py:153 - rows[:6] train, rows[6:] held; ordered slice, not random, not stratified

train.state: 红印章@窗台, 蓝杯子@木桌

coverage.state_overlap: none; train states and held states are disjoint placements of the same two objects
coverage.conclusion: held 集 2/3 的正确动作对应的地点在训练中从未作为正确答案出现，且 held 的状态与 train 的状态完全不重叠

finding: 10.7f 的负结果是切分缺陷下的零样本泛化测试：模型在训练中只见过「左盒/窗台」作为答案，留出主要考「木桌」。任何参数化形状在同一划分上都无法把「木桌」作为答案选出，因为该标签在训练分布中概率为零。因此 readout_selection_absent 不构成对参数化形状的否证。
what_it_does_not_overturn: 10.7f 的原始读数有效：该实验确实测了「6 样本顺序切分能否泛化」，答案是不能
10.7f 的训练内拟合成 5.03e-06 有效：1,536 参数在 6 样本上可以完全记住
10.7 的二级结论有效：主体在该任务上学到的是常量偏置
报告自承的「读出只读 goal/state/action 编码、不读循环状态 h」这一限制仍然成立
what_it_does_overturn: 把 10.7f 用作「参数化形状是瓶颈」的证据 —— 该推论不成立
第 05 号裁决中「最窄可证伪缺口＝在同一 6 样本夹具上换外积读出」的前提 —— 同一划分下换任何参数化都会空转
把 10.7f 与 10.7e-1 的失败合并成一句「读出线整体不可行」—— 两者都在不同切分缺陷下测了别的东西

same_pattern_elsewhere.defect: 按局面切分，480 样本只有 20 个目标，一个目标都没留出，三臂 100%
按目标对象留出，旧三臂 0%，报告自陈不能排除表示/优化/样本量
顺序切分，留出 4/6 是零样本地点

next.design: stratified split: every place and every object must appear as a correct answer in train; held-out is unseen (object, place) combination only, never an unseen label value
next.comparison: flat scoring vs input-conditioned outer product, same data, same budget
next.criterion: held-out six-way top-1 strictly greater than best constant; both arms reported

followup_14_2.reading: fair stratified split: held 6/6 vs best constant 1/6; zero-state control 6/6; shuffled-state control 6/6
followup_14_2.conclusion: state is not read at all. The 6/6 comes from copying the goal string, which is byte-identical to the correct action string (both are 把X放到Y). The fixture leaks the answer through the goal text.
followup_14_2.impact: 10.7f cannot be used as evidence for or against the parameterisation shape; its failure is a fixture leak plus a zero-shot-label split. The only leak-free selection fixture in the repo is 10.21 (goal omits entity names, vocabulary only from records), where 10.21.4 already returned reader_selection_absent.
followup_14_2.what_it_strengthens: 10.21.4's negative verdict is not explainable by a goal-copy shortcut, because its goal text never names the entity.

cost.note: read-only; one import of the fixture and one ordered listing

limits: Audit only. Does not retrain, does not change any frozen verdict, does not claim any capability. 10.7f report and checkpoint are untouched.
